headline: MITHRIL CONFIRMS 550m SILVER-GOLD STRIKE AT COPALQUIN TARGET 4 — 13.95m AT 387 g/t AgEq WITH PEAK ASSAY OF 3,877 g/t AgEq IN DURANGO, MEXICO
snippet: Mithril Silver and Gold (ASX: MTH) reported wide, high-grade intercepts from the first systematic drilling of Target 4 at its Copalquin property in Durango State, Mexico: best results include 13.95 metres at 387 g/t silver-equivalent and 11.70 metres at 456 g/t AgEq, with a peak assay of 3,877 g/t AgEq over 0.60 metres. Drilling has now confirmed mineralisation across approximately 550 metres of strike with 200 metres of vertical extent — and the system remains open along strike and at depth — transforming Copalquin into a district-scale silver-gold target with multiple structural corridors still untested.

headline: AMERICAN EAGLE DRILLS 411m AT 0.43% CuEq IN FIRST STEP-OUT EAST OF NAK SOUTH ZONE — PORPHYRY SYSTEM EXPANDING INTO UNMAPPED GROUND
snippet: American Eagle Gold (TSXV: AEA) released results from hole NAK26-89, which intersected 411 metres grading 0.43% copper equivalent from 47 metres depth, within a broader 880-metre envelope of 0.30% CuEq — the first 2026 step-out drilled east of the South Zone at the NAK porphyry project in B.C. The result follows August 18's 1,001-metre-wide intercept at 0.46% CuEq and confirms the system is growing laterally into previously undrilled ground; 18 of a planned 80-hole, 55,000-metre program are completed with three rigs drilling continuously.

headline: GOLD ABOVE $4,600 AND SILVER AT $69 AS YIELDS AND DOLLAR FALL AHEAD OF WARSH'S JACKSON HOLE DEBUT FRIDAY
snippet: Spot gold recovered above $4,600 and silver held near $69 per ounce on Thursday, August 27, as Treasury yields and the U.S. dollar retreated ahead of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's inaugural Jackson Hole keynote Friday morning — signalling that markets view any hawkish surprise as manageable against structurally bullish fundamentals. The pre-speech positioning reversal comes after Wednesday's PCE-driven selloff; a Bank of America fund survey shows 53% expect Warsh to take a neutral big-picture tone, with 31% braced for hawkish language.

headline: 1911 GOLD EXTENDS SAM W VEIN TO 500m STRIKE AND 600m DEPTH AT TRUE NORTH MANITOBA — HIGH-GRADE INTERCEPTS CONFIRM STRUCTURAL CONTINUITY
snippet: 1911 Gold Corporation (TSXV: AUMB) released assay results from eight surface drill holes at the SAM W target at its True North Gold Project in Bissett, Manitoba, including headline intercepts of 11.31 g/t gold over 1.70 metres and 6.79 g/t gold over 2.40 metres. The holes confirm continuity of the SAM W vein system over a 500-metre strike length and to down-plunge depths exceeding 600 metres — extending the system well beyond its previously known dimensions and building the resource case for a near-mine exploration target at a property with existing infrastructure.

headline: WEST RED LAKE GOLD'S MADSEN MINE POSTS 51% GOLD PRODUCTION JUMP AND 30% AISC REDUCTION IN Q2 — ON TRACK FOR 35,000–45,000 OZ ANNUAL GUIDANCE
snippet: West Red Lake Gold Mines (TSXV: WRLG) reported Q2 2026 results showing gold production of 8,576 ounces — a 51% increase over Q1 — with gold sales rising 34% to 8,260 ounces and all-in sustaining costs falling 30% quarter-over-quarter. The Madsen Mine in Ontario's Red Lake District is demonstrating steady operational improvement since declaring commercial production in early 2026, and management confirmed full-year guidance of 35,000 to 45,000 ounces remains intact — a rare production ramp story in the current market.

headline: CLSA RAISES GOLD FORECAST TO $4,840 IN 2026, $5,130 IN 2027, $5,500 BY 2028 — Lifts Long-Term Floor to $3,500 on Mining Cost Inflation and Money Supply Growth
snippet: CLSA's latest research note upgrades its gold price forecasts to $4,840 for 2026, $5,130 for 2027, and $5,500 per ounce for 2028, citing a bottom-up cost analysis combined with accelerating U.S. money supply growth as the primary structural drivers. The bank also raised its long-term gold price assumption to $3,500 per ounce, marking a significant reset of the long-term floor. The Kitco/GoldSeek Gold SWOT analysis flags this as a meaningful institutional bullish inflection at a time when gold is working through a consolidation phase near $4,600.

headline: GDXJ MID-TIERS ACHIEVE RECORD 28.8% AISC-TO-GOLD RATIO IN Q2 — Cash Treasuries Hit $18B All-Time High as Margins Expand to Historic Levels
snippet: Adam Hamilton's quarterly GoldSeek analysis of GDXJ's top 25 mid-tier producers shows the group achieved a record-low all-in sustaining cost-to-gold-price ratio of 28.8% in Q2 2026 — meaning producers kept less than 29 cents of every dollar of AISC relative to spot gold, generating margins that are historically unprecedented. Operating cash flows surged 36.3% year-over-year to $6.24 billion and total cash treasuries soared 45.2% to a record $17.97 billion — a fundamental backdrop the analysis argues the market has not yet fully repriced into mid-tier equity multiples.

headline: ONTARIO BREAKS GROUND ON MARTEN FALLS COMMUNITY ACCESS ROAD — Ring of Fire Critical Mineral Corridor Now 4 Years Ahead of Schedule
snippet: Construction has commenced on the Marten Falls Community Access Road — the first all-season road connecting the Ring of Fire critical mineral district in northern Ontario to the provincial highway network — four years ahead of the previously announced 2035 schedule. The Ring of Fire spans roughly 8,000 square kilometres approximately 540 kilometres north of Thunder Bay and is considered one of Canada's largest undeveloped sources of nickel, chromium, and other battery metals. Marten Falls First Nation and Ontario co-signed a joint economic partnership agreement worth $39.5 million alongside the groundbreaking.

headline: VISIONARY METALS MOBILIZES FOR 4,500m AT WYOMING'S FIRST NICKEL DISCOVERY — Teck Contributes $800K Direct Funding as King Solomon and Tin Cup Drilling Begins Late August
snippet: Visionary Metals Corp. (TSXV: VIZ) is mobilizing for up to 4,500 metres of diamond drilling across eight separate magmatic nickel and copper sulphide targets at its King Solomon and Tin Cup projects in Fremont County, Wyoming — site of the state's first confirmed nickel sulphide discovery. The 2026 drill program is backed by Teck American Incorporated under an exploration alliance that contributes C$800,000 in direct funding plus C$300,000 in technical services, alongside a US$250,000 Wyoming Energy Matching Funds grant. King Solomon drilling targets three high-conductance electromagnetic anomalies beginning late August.

headline: GOLD, SILVER AND COPPER ALL SHOWING STRUCTURAL BREAKOUTS — GoldSeek Weekly Flags Converging Commodity Cycles and Tightening Physical Markets
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly precious and base metals update argues that gold, silver, and copper are all simultaneously in structural bull phases driven by distinct but reinforcing catalysts — central bank gold demand, six-year physical silver supply deficits, and mine supply constraints amplified by the DRC flooding at Kamoa-Kakula. The convergence of three separate commodity bull cycles is historically rare and the analysis contends that investors underweight any one of the three face meaningful opportunity cost heading into Q4 2026.
